annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds persons (including manufacturers and owners) operating fully autonomous vehicles, who must submit law enforcement interaction plans, proof of financial responsibility, and report accidents; it also preempts counties and municipalities.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Prior to operating a fully autonomous vehicle on the public roads of this state without a human driver, a person shall submit to the Department of Public Safety a law enforcement interaction plan
annotation.dates_quote: SECTION 13.   This act shall become effective November 1, 2022.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: An Act relating to motor vehicles; allowing for operation of fully autonomous vehicles; stating conditions for operation
